steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Weapon reliability certification?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: What's that about?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: You need me to take my weapon down to the workshop for inspection, and have the people there sign off on it?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Do we really have to go through all that just because I brought my own weapon...?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Can't you bend the rules a little bit, Professor? Just sign off for me.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: You can't? We have procedures?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: That's lame. Okay, okay. I'll head over there if you insist.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: I only just got here. I don't want to get on Dr. Kal'tsit's bad side.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: I'll see you later, Professor.
Rhodes Island Landship, Workshop No. 3, Morning

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Anybody home?
Hello there. The workshop isn't open right now. All five of our craftsmen are involved in a weapon repair contest.
If you need anything, please come back after 3 o'clock.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: A weapon repair contest? They really have contests for everything, don't they?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: How does it work? Do you break the weapons first and then repair them? Or is it about who polishes a shinier blade?
Sorry to disappoint, but it's just a contest where you repair weapons damaged out in the field.
But if you manage to make a weapon shiny enough to give it a deadly glint, I suppose you'd have a fair chance of winning.
...Hm? That doesn't sound like a bad idea. I'll give it a try next time.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Ha, you weirdo. Well, have fun with that.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: I don't want to have to come all the way down here again. The craftsmen may not be around, but you're here.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: It's just some routine inspection anyway. No need to take it so seriously. How about it, friend? Give it a quick look-over and sign right here?
Weapon reliability certification?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: That's right.
Your weapon needs to be inspected by two craftsmen before it can be approved.
And I'm technically still an intern assistant. I'm afraid signing my name there isn't going to do you much help.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: So it needs to be signed off by two people. Perfect. We've got two people right here, you and me.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: I know my staff better than anyone else, and I know for certain there is nothing wrong with it. If nothing happens, no one is going to find out, and if no one finds out, then we don't have a problem. Am I right?
Oh, that's an interesting way to think about it.
I don't recommend underestimating the people here, though. Definitely not the strict ones.
If something does happen, there's going to be quite a ruckus. Even though they aren't here right now, all the craftsmen will face punishment. It'll be even worse for the two of us.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Tsk, so inflexible.
It may be inflexible, but it's effective. There are people who don't maintain their weapons well.
Trust me. This is much easier than having to fix things on the fly out in the field.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: What kind of moron doesn't take care of his weapons?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Fine. In that case...

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Take a look at my weapon.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: You can at least do that for me, right? It'd really piss me off if I had to come all the way here for nothing.
Oh... sure. Just a moment.
Let me tighten this last screw... okay.
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Hm... That look on your face tells me you are still planning something. It doesn't seem like you've quite given up yet.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: I'm not sure I understand.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Here you go. This is my staff.
Eh... Oh well.
Okay, I'll inspect it for you.
(Quietly) Just be careful with it, don't cause any accidents, and it should be fine, right...?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: I'm counting on you.
The inspection is going to take some time. Could you please wait here while I work on it?
You are free to look around, but try not to touch anything in the workshop. Some of the craftsmen here like to work on dangerous things...
You know what I mean, right? The ones they haven't finished yet are even more dangerous.
On top of that, we have a lot of ores here with Originium in them... You may be Infected, but you should still be careful.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: No need to worry about me. I'm not that adventurous.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: ...Wait a second.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Now that's weird. Did I ever tell you I'm Infected?
No, you didn't. But it isn't hard to tell.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Explain. Is it obvious?
Hmm... How can I put it?
I guess it's just by observation. There is quite a lot you can learn from someone's expressions, actions, and the logic in his behavior.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: It sounds kinda like you're pulling my leg.
I'm telling the truth.
Is this staff the only thing you need me to inspect? If there is anything else, I can take a look at those as well.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Nope, that's it.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: I don't have a gun, unfortunately.
What a coincidence. Me neither.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: You're kind of weird. Intriguing.
Hm... thanks?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: That's not a compliment.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: There aren't any problems with the staff. Just a quick glance should be enough.
I have to look it over thoroughly.
Hmm... the materials that went into this staff are top grade.
Is the thing hanging from your staff a Caster Source as well?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Yes. But more importantly, and this is what I like about it, I can beat people up with it.
Good thinking. It must come in handy in close quarters combat.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: What's your name, craftsman?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Well, I'm not exactly a craftsman.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I'm Adnachiel, Reserve Op Team A4. I'm also an intern in this repair workshop.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Arene.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Your name really fits you.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Hm... the main Arts Unit doesn't look like it has any damage to it, and the Caster Source hanging there doesn't have any apparent damage or cracks, either.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: It looks like it's in pretty good shape.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Hehe, what did I tell you?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Okay, moving on, could you activate your Originium Arts with your staff? I need to check its feedback during use and verify its performance.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Just use my Arts here? My Arts are kind of wild.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Oh, could you describe what it's like?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Disintegrative and toxic.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Wow, that does sound fairly dangerous.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: In that case, why don't you put your staff in that transparent cabinet there? Then just put your hand in from the opening on the side and use your Arts.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: That way, even if your Arts are as volatile as you said, we shouldn't have anything to worry about.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Sounds like a pan.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Do I have to...?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Okay, fine.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Will this do it?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Okay, that's good. I'll activate the machine.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Don't worry if you feel pressure in your arm. That's normal.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Okay, we're ready!

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: You can use your Originium Arts now. No need to worry about hurting me.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: I won't.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: (Uses Originium Arts)

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Alright, we're done here!

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I'll take care of the rest. Just leave me your staff and take a break over there.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Most Sankta are care about guns and crossbows. You look like you're pretty familiar with staves too. Are all Sankta outside Laterano like this?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: It's just the master craftsman I work with, Iron Hammer, is an expert in maintaining and forging staves. I also have some friends on my team who need their weapons looked after.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: He's an expert in staves, but his codename is Iron Hammer?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: The craftsmen here are all pretty laid-back with their names. It left me dumbfounded for the better part of the day when I first got here.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Look, their badges are all there.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: You can take a look if you're interested.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Don't mind if I do.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: (Repair Workshop No. 3 - List of Personnel)

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: (Iron Hammer, Tincan, Rock, Wreck Shield, and Gunject...)

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: (That's more than being just laid-back...)

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: (This might be a good opportunity, though...)

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Do they have to stencil their signatures on their badges?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Of course not.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: That's just something they all did one time out of spite.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: There was this one day they had an argument over craftsmanship, so they all competed against each other making their own badges using their respective trades.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: After they cooled their heads, they all thought it was pretty fun, and agreed to wear the badges they made themselves in the workshop, and only use the standard issue ones outside.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Interesting, isn't it?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Yeah... That's... very interesting.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: (Their signatures are all here.)

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: (It's all handwritten, too.)

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: (Perfect. This will save me a lot of work. I just need to get my hands on two of these...)

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: *Glances*

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: (Ha, perfect timing.)

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: (Stamp this here...)

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: (Done. These Originium Arts really come in handy.)

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: (Hm? This signature is in Lateran.)

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Hey, Adnachiel. Who's this guy?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Oh, that's Gunject.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: He's from Laterano, just like us.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: He doesn't like to make anything gun-related, just swords.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: So he doesn't have a gun?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Oh, he has one, but he doesn't like guns, as a thing.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I heard he left his at home in Laterano, and he hasn't been back since.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: 'There's nothing but bullet casings in that place. Just the sight of it gives me a headache. '

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: That's what he said.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: I agree with him.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: I have a feeling I'll get along with him pretty well.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Well, unfortunately, he got into a fight with his family over that. He can't even go home anymore.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: If he really hates guns so much, I can't imagine him having many fond memories of Laterano.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Does he still want to go back in spite of it all?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Is Laterano such a great place that it takes everyone down memory lane?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Now that you mention it, I never thought about it.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: What about you? Do you miss Laterano?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Hm... Hard to say.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I haven't lived there for a long time.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Because of my halo, you see.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: After that, I contracted Oripathy, which means I really don't have a way to go back.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Wait, so your halo doesn't float like that because of Oripathy?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Nope, I was born differently.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: That's... kind of sad.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: When I was a kid, my parents always praised me and said that with a smile, so I've always thought of myself as pretty lucky.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I was born different than others. Doesn't that sound cool?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Oh, of course, it's just a joke.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Don't be modest. You are very different from the other weirdos here. In a bad way.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Really? And here I thought I was pretty normal...

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I'm not that different from other Sankta. In fact, I have a lot in common with them.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Such as? What do you have in common with them?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Such as... let's see, like how I can't wear a hat?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Hahahahahahaha!

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Ahem, yeah, you're right. That's true.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Wearing a hat is like getting stuffed into an egg with no cracks. It's gross.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Other than the Notarial Hall people or the Apostolic Knights, with all their training, I don't think there are many Sankta who could stand to wear a hat. Maybe some weirdos who love to fight.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: True.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: In any case, maybe it's because of my halo, but I couldn't get my firearm qualifications, and my family moved out of Laterano shortly after that.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: And I was Infected not long after.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Laterano doesn't permit Infected in its borders. I'm sure you haven't been back since your infection, am I correct?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: ...Yeah.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: That's why... I don't feel particularly nostalgic about Laterano.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I don't remember a lot about my childhood there, either.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Oh, but I still remember the baker down the street, John!

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: He taught me how to make desserts, and he even put all his recipes in a book for me when I moved away!

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: (Tsk... Here we go. The Sankta and their sweet tooth.)

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I really wish I didn't lose that book in the move... *Sigh*

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: (My parents got me a huge cake every year. They knew I couldn't finish it all, but they still left me home alone to deal with that block of sugary mess by myself.)

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: At the very least, my Warhead muffins are no less decadent than the muffins John used to make.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I can still remember the aroma of his dessert shop.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: (I remember that smell too. Every time I smell it, my throat starts to ache.)

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Oh, I see you don't like desserts.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I think you're the first Laterano I've met who doesn't.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: ...You can tell?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I don't normally tell people I can see through them, since they don't like it much. Most times I just keep my mouth shut.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: It doesn't seem like you mind, though.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Yeah, it's fine.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: I don't mind. Weirdos like you are more interesting than normal people.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I think you're much more of a weirdo for not liking desserts.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I'll try to make some that aren't as sweet. You'll have to give them a try.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I wonder if the old baker is doing well...

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Maybe I should ask the Messengers at Logistics to help me out.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: I've come to understand one thing.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: You're a Laterano Sankta through and through.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Even though you don't have a gun, and your halo's tilted.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I still have memories of that place, and it's just the city that I can't go back to, not my home. Your hometown is something you can always reach out for, no matter when or where.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: There's travel, mail, messages, and photos that can move between the cities.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: If we really want to reminisce about our home countries, there are a lot of convenient ways for us to do that.
You know, I get what you're saying.
But there's also people who like to revisit a place, to smell and touch it in person. Otherwise, they get homesick.
Well, not that I care.
Just remember to gimme some of those desserts.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Hello, Ambriel.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Hiyas.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Oh, heyas, new meat.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: So what's your name, cutie?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Arene.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Hi there, Arene.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Adnachiel, you know the drill. Take care of my gun, okay?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: You can just leave it over there. I'm still working on Arene's weapon.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Sure—

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Hm? What's that smell? It smells so good! It's unlike anything on the market...

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Is one of you guys wearing perfume?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: If you like how I smell, come get all the sniffs you want.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Hmm... think I'm gonna pass.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Something tells me that's not a good idea.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: But if that smell can knock me out for the whole day, I'll think about it.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: You know that guy with the poker face? He's trying to get me to 'fulfill my obligations' again.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Instead of running away all the time, I'm thinking it makes hella more sense if I just pass out for the day.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Actually, those guys are so braindead, just a day probably isn't gonna be enough.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Argh, what a pain in the butt.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: The guy with the poker face... You mean the one from the Notarial Hall?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Who else?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: They haven't come for you yet? Like, to oversee your fulfillment of your obligations as a citizen and all that?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: They have.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: But the last guy who kicked my door down while I was taking a nap is still running around, taking care of some business for me.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: They may be trouble, but they also know how to take care of troubles.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: If you figure out how to use them, they aren't so bad.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Whoa, you sound like such a baddie. Nice.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Should I say thanks?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: No thanks.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Arene, I'm finished inspecting your staff!

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: The casting circuits have corroded a little, but everything else is fine.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: The tiny bit of corrosion isn't going to affect your Arts, but if you want me to do some maintenance work on it, I can take care of that right now.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: When the craftsmen are here in the afternoon, you can come back and have them sign the certification.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: (Quietly) Even if it looks like you don't need them to.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Here you go.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Now let's take a look at Ambriel's rifle... Hmm.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: It's all yours.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: You don't work on the gun yourself?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: I do.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: But that's such a pain sometimes. This is easier.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Just wait for it to break.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Well... I can't have that.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: If I lose my gun, I lose my pay.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: And if I lose my pay, I lose any chance to slack off.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: I'm not that stupid.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Hmm... You're more serious than I thought.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: If I didn't need my gun to get by, I wouldn't mind letting it gather dust in my closet.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Oh, I guess I could probably do that in Laterano, but if I actually left it to gather dust, I'd have some relative on my case the very next day.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: That's why I gave up on that idea.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Ambriel, your rifle's fine.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: It didn't have any problems to begin with. I calibrated it just last week.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: You just gotta put some oil on it and we should be good.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Do you think keeping a gun around is a hassle at times like these?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: It's not bad.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: I get by somehow.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Just like when you ran all the way here from Laterano?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: You don't hold back, do you? You'll never be popular with girls if you're that blunt up front, you know?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: My apologies, then. Were you offended?

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Not really.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: You're right. It's more or less like that. I'm not very a good fit for that place.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Rather than having to defend the city and get yelled at about glory and honor all day, I'd rather make myself some money.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: There's less to worry about, and life's a lot more comfortable.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: What's not to like?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: It sounds like you don't have many fond memories of Laterano.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: If life's not bad, anywhere's fine.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: It's not like there's a rule that Sankta have to live out their lives in Laterano anyway.

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: The world's a big place. Gotta see more of it.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Your rifle's ready, Ambriel!

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Thanks!

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: Yep, I couldn't make it prettier if I tried!

steps.name: Ambriel
steps.text: You two keep talking. I'll head back and chill. Laters.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: See ya!

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: It's almost time for lunch. Is there anything else you need me to look at?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: If not, I'll lock up and head out to eat.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Do you want to get lunch together?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: No, I already have plans with Executor. You know, from the Notarial Hall. It seems like he has something important to tell me.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Do you think he'd owe me one if I told him Ambriel stopped by here?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Uh? That's a joke, isn't it?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: It is.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: You really joke around quite a lot.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I can tell you're kidding, but others might not be able to tell, so I suggest you be a little more careful with that.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: No need to worry about me.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Oh yeah, are you going to be around this afternoon?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Hm? Yeah. I will be back here after lunch.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: You know, your observation is on another level, but there's one thing you got wrong.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: I'll be back this afternoon.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: It sounds like this Gunject is a pretty interesting person. I wouldn't mind stopping by again just to meet him.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: I'll see you again in the afternoon.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: I'm back, Professor.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Of course. I went to the workshop.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Oh... I can't give you this, though.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: You can tell? There's no one at the workshop, unfortunately. I copied their signatures. They didn't sign off on it.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: *Sigh*... i thought I would turn this in and get it over with, but you saw right through it. Adnachiel was right. The Doctor is sharp.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Don't worry. I'll go there again in the afternoon. Give me another certification form. I'll get their real signatures after they finish with their competition.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Hm? I got more honest all of a sudden?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Haha, don't say that, Professor. Haven't I always followed your instructions?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Eh, come on, don't give me that look.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Why did I change my mind?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: I met a lot of interesting people, and it's not a bad idea to spend a little more time because of that.

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: How's that?

steps.name: Arene
steps.text: Is that a good reason?
